**Find f(3):**
f(3) = 2(3)² - 4(3) + 9
f(3) = 2(9) - 12 + 9
f(3) = 18 - 12 + 9
f(3) = 15

**Find f(-3):**
f(-3) = 2(-3)² - 4(-3) + 9
f(-3) = 2(9) + 12 + 9
f(-3) = 18 + 12 + 9
f(-3) = 39

**Calculate 2f(3) + 3f(-3):**
2f(3) + 3f(-3) = 2(15) + 3(39)
= 30 + 117
= **147**
